name: Stormbringer: Crackling Devastation and Jolt modify Electrocute natively (#2773, #3109)
contract: #2773 and #3109 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two passives that are plain Spell.dbc modifiers on Electrocute (501421-501432/801844, SpellFamilyName 22, SchoolMask 8 Nature, DmgClass 1 Magic). #2773: Crackling Devastation (705645) is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, misc 15 SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30%, class mask word1 2097152 intersecting Electrocute's own SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 21. Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus computes a magic spell's crit bonus as damage/2 (500 on a base of 1000, giving 1500 total) then runs that 500 bonus through Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS); +30% turns 500 into 650, for a total of 1650, i.e. +150 over the unmodified 1500. #3109: Jolt rank 1 (707054) and rank 2 (707859) each carry effect0 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 0 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (EffectBasePoints 14/29 + 1 = +15%/+30%) and effect1 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 7 SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (EffectBasePoints 14/29 + 1 = +15/+30 points), both effects' class mask word0 33554432 intersecting Electrocute's SpellFamilyFlags[0] bit 25. SPELLMOD_DAMAGE is consumed generically wherever direct spell damage is totalled (Unit.cpp) and reads back through spell_damage_done's own base-1000 calculation as a ratio; SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE is consumed in Unit::SpellDoneCritChance, which is exactly what the spell_done_crit_chance metric calls, so a flat +15/+30 point delta is observed there directly (the separate spell_crit_chance metric reads the player's raw PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1 stat field, which these classmask-scoped per-spell modifiers never touch, and would show no change). SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no special case for family 22, so all three ops are consumed by stock, non-class-specific core code with no module script needed. All values are the server's own computed metrics, snapshotted on the same actor before and after learning each passive.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Electrocute critical damage without Crackling Devastation
BASELINE: Electrocute direct damage without Jolt
BASELINE: Electrocute crit chance without Jolt
DISCRIMINATING: Crackling Devastation raises Electrocute's critical damage by 30% of the crit bonus (1500 -> 1650)
Crackling Devastation does not change Electrocute's direct damage
Unlearn Crackling Devastation before isolating Jolt
Unlearning Crackling Devastation restores Electrocute's critical damage
DISCRIMINATING: Jolt rank 1 raises Electrocute's direct damage by 15%
DISCRIMINATING: Jolt rank 1 raises Electrocute's crit chance by 15 points
Unlearn Jolt rank 1 before isolating rank 2
Unlearning Jolt rank 1 restores Electrocute's direct damage
DISCRIMINATING: Jolt rank 2 raises Electrocute's direct damage by 30%
DISCRIMINATING: Jolt rank 2 raises Electrocute's crit chance by 30 points
